decisions.reason: A complete same-message MODIFY already captures the Hero V height-only study, replaces the prior length instruction, and removes the obsolete right-arm-length attributes.
A complete same-message MODIFY already replaces the length-based endpoint rule with the proportional 0–3% height study across the signature forms.
A same-message MODIFY already records the future proportional endpoint-height application to the É accent and removes its obsolete endpoint-length adjustment.
A complete same-message MODIFY already locks the original Option B terminal geometry while endpoint height is evaluated as the sole variable.
The source changes signature-form endpoint geometry but does not change the selected kerning, baseline, composition rhythm, or internal-letter hierarchy.
The height-only study concerns the Hero V and second V, with later proportional application to the É accent; it does not change the construction or scale rules for the remaining letterforms.
The source isolates endpoint height and makes no decision about the champagne-gold finish, distribution, or material-treatment preference.
The calibrated endpoint-height study implements the established quiet-elevation direction without changing the broader brand-expression requirements.
The endpoint-height refinement does not change the decision to use a proprietary wordmark without a separate icon or monogram.
The source concerns an in-progress geometric study and does not alter the production-ready asset deliverable.
